接待 JUAN 入住的體驗好嗎？

   告訴Juan的一行幾人您喜歡他們的什麼方面，以及有什麼可以做得更好

Juan的群體剛剛退房，現在是您撰寫評價的最佳時間。

評價是Airbnb社區的重要組成部分。請為您的房客留下有用的回饋意見，這只需要花上您幾分鐘的時間。

撰寫評價
[https://www.airbnb.com.tw/hosting/reviews/1414972583657181524/edit?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=07a3b059-52ca-24f9-f551-2799bb322d9a]

評價的重要性

房東社區的成員仰賴彼此的分享經驗，在出租時便能放心待客。


想想你接待房客的經驗，以及對方在尊重你的房源和守則時所付出的努力。你想讓其他房東知道什麼？


真誠的意見可以建立信任，因此你和房東均可評價入住／接待體驗，而我們只會在 14 天或雙方均寫完評價後才發布內容。

body:
%opentrack%

https://www.airbnb.com.tw/?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=4415c472-82a0-e23b-42c9-7a04e7d31e5b

接待 JAMES 入住的體驗好嗎？

   JAMES
   
   5月4日至8日
   
   The Creative Loft Xinyi | Walk to 101+Night Market

分享你的體驗，以便 James 及其房東知道接待體驗如何。

撰寫評價
[https://www.airbnb.com.tw/hosting/reviews/1416366826704081584/edit?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=4415c472-82a0-e23b-42c9-7a04e7d31e5b]

評價的重要性

房東社區的成員仰賴彼此的分享經驗，在出租時便能放心待客。

   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.

   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be
   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.
   2. No Running in Hallways – For safety and respect to
   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.
   3. Turn Off Lights When Unused (Eco Friendly)– Kindly turn
   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other
   shared areas when not in use.
   4. Pool Etiquette – Please wear proper swimwear and a swim
   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.
   5. Contact Us Directly – If you encounter any issues, please
   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning. You

   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning. You
   don't have to wash them for the team. However, your
   thoughtfulness is well recevied.

   達人
   
   Dear Sharad,
   Welcome and thank you for staying with us! Before you settle
   in, please take a moment to review these important house
   rules to ensure a smooth and pleasant experience for
   everyone:
   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be
   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.
   2. No Running in Hallways – For safety and respect to
   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.
   3. Turn Off Lights When Unused (Eco Friendly)– Kindly turn
   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other
   shared areas when not in use.
   4. Pool Etiquette – Please wear proper swimwear and a swim
   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.
   5. Contact Us Directly – If you encounter any issues, please
   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning. You
   don't have to wash them for the team. However, your
   thoughtfulness is well recevied.
   
   Thank you for your cooperation, and we hope you have a
   wonderful stay!

subject: 為Christopher的一行幾人撰寫評價
body:
%opentrack%

https://www.airbnb.com.tw/?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=d8bcd909-a523-ff2d-acc0-937396d99f1c

接待 CHRISTOPHER 入住的體驗好嗎？

   告訴Christopher的一行幾人您喜歡他們的什麼方面，以及有什麼可以做得更好

Christopher的群體剛剛退房，現在是您撰寫評價的最佳時間。

評價是Airbnb社區的重要組成部分。請為您的房客留下有用的回饋意見，這只需要花上您幾分鐘的時間。

撰寫評價
[https://www.airbnb.com.tw/hosting/reviews/1425810972630094277/edit?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=d8bcd909-a523-ff2d-acc0-937396d99f1c]

評價的重要性

房東社區的成員仰賴彼此的分享經驗，在出租時便能放心待客。

   in, please take a moment to review these important house
   rules to ensure a smooth and pleasant experience for
   everyone:
   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be
   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.
   2. No Running in Hallways – For safety and respect to
   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.
   3. Turn Off Lights When Unused (Eco Friendly)– Kindly turn
   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other
   shared areas when not in use.
   4. Pool Etiquette – Please wear proper swimwear and a swim
   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.
   5. Contact Us Directly – If you encounter any issues, please
   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning. You
   don't have to wash them for the team. However, your
   thoughtfulness is well recevied.
   
   Thank you for your cooperation, and we hope you have a
   wonderful stay!

評價是Airbnb社區的重要組成部分。請為您的房客留下有用的回饋意見，這只需要花上您幾分鐘的時間。

撰寫評價

想想你接待房客的經驗，以及對方在尊重你的房源和守則時所付出的努力。你想讓其他房東知道什麼？

   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.

   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.

Marguerite和Rochelle剛剛退房，現在是您撰寫評價的最佳時間。

評價是Airbnb社區的重要組成部分。請為您的房客留下有用的回饋意見。這只需要花上您幾分鐘的時間。

撰寫評價
[https://www.airbnb.com.tw/hosting/reviews/1433862012074130216/edit?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=559e3284-286f-1919-c193-8c8634680569]

評價的重要性

房東社區的成員仰賴彼此的分享經驗，在出租時便能放心待客。


想想你接待房客的經驗，以及對方在尊重你的房源和守則時所付出的努力。你想讓其他房東知道什麼？

   Welcome and thank you for staying with us! Before you settle

   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be
   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.
   2. No Running in Hallways – For safety and respect to
   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.
   3. Turn Off Lights When Unused (Eco Friendly)– Kindly turn
   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other
   shared areas when not in use.
   4. Pool Etiquette – Please wear proper swimwear and a swim
   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.
   5. Contact Us Directly – If you encounter any issues, please
   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Make sure to log out of your Google and Netflix accounts
   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original
   settings.
   10. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning.
   You don't have to wash them for the team. However, your
   thoughtfulness is well recevied.
   
   Thank you for your cooperation, and we hope you have a
   wonderful stay!

   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be
   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.
   2. No Running in Hallways – For safety and respect to
   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.
   3. Turn Off Lights When Unused (Eco Friendly)– Kindly turn
   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other

   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.

   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Make sure to log out of your Google and Netflix accounts
   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original
   settings.
   10. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning.

subject: 為Joanne的一行幾人撰寫評價
body:
%opentrack%

https://www.airbnb.com.tw/?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=6ad236ee-1868-8c9d-af81-5bc55e2ef48a

接待 JOANNE 入住的體驗好嗎？

   告訴Joanne的一行幾人您喜歡他們的什麼方面，以及有什麼可以做得更好

Joanne的群體剛剛退房，現在是您撰寫評價的最佳時間。

評價是Airbnb社區的重要組成部分。請為您的房客留下有用的回饋意見，這只需要花上您幾分鐘的時間。

撰寫評價
[https://www.airbnb.com.tw/hosting/reviews/1440286222132097455/edit?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=6ad236ee-1868-8c9d-af81-5bc55e2ef48a]

評價的重要性

房東社區的成員仰賴彼此的分享經驗，在出租時便能放心待客。

   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.

   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.

   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.

   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original

   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be
   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.
   2. No Running in Hallways – For safety and respect to
   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.
   3. Turn Off Lights When Unused (Eco Friendly)– Kindly turn
   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other
   shared areas when not in use.
   4. Pool Etiquette – Please wear proper swimwear and a swim
   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.
   5. Contact Us Directly – If you encounter any issues, please
   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Make sure to log out of your Google and Netflix accounts
   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original
   settings.
   10. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning.
   You don't have to wash them for the team. However, your
   thoughtfulness is well recevied.
   
   Thank you for your cooperation, and we hope you have a
   wonderful stay!

評價是Airbnb社區的重要組成部分。請為您的房客留下有用的回饋意見，這只需要花上您幾分鐘的時間。

撰寫評價

評價的重要性

房東社區的成員仰賴彼此的分享經驗，在出租時便能放心待客。


想想你接待房客的經驗，以及對方在尊重你的房源和守則時所付出的努力。你想讓其他房東知道什麼？

   Dear Taylor,
   Welcome and thank you for staying with us! Before you settle
   in, please take a moment to review these important house
   rules to ensure a smooth and pleasant experience for
   everyone:
   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be
   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.
   2. No Running in Hallways – For safety and respect to
   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.
   3. Turn Off Lights When Unused (Eco Friendly)– Kindly turn
   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other
   shared areas when not in use.
   4. Pool Etiquette – Please wear proper swimwear and a swim
   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.
   5. Contact Us Directly – If you encounter any issues, please
   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Make sure to log out of your Google and Netflix accounts
   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original
   settings.
   10. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning.
   You don't have to wash them for the team. However, your
   thoughtfulness is well recevied.
   
   Thank you for your cooperation, and we hope you have a
   wonderful stay!

subject: 為Susan的一行幾人撰寫評價
body:
%opentrack%

https://www.airbnb.com.tw/?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=e084a17d-5b56-3f89-633c-ef6d7e97fcff

接待 SUSAN 入住的體驗好嗎？

   告訴Susan的一行幾人您喜歡他們的什麼方面，以及有什麼可以做得更好

Susan的群體剛剛退房，現在是您撰寫評價的最佳時間。

評價是Airbnb社區的重要組成部分。請為您的房客留下有用的回饋意見，這只需要花上您幾分鐘的時間。

撰寫評價
[https://www.airbnb.com.tw/hosting/reviews/1453349906783519267/edit?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=e084a17d-5b56-3f89-633c-ef6d7e97fcff]

評價的重要性

房東社區的成員仰賴彼此的分享經驗，在出租時便能放心待客。

[https://www.airbnb.com.tw/help/article/209?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZXNfbWVzc2FnaW5nL25ld19tZXNzYWdl&euid=eeddf9e2-8138-bc65-042c-56594bd9128d]。

   SIMON
   
   達人
   
   Dear Wolfgang,
   Welcome and thank you for staying with us! Before you settle
   in, please take a moment to review these important house
   rules to ensure a smooth and pleasant experience for
   everyone:
   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be
   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.
   2. No Running in Hallways – For safety and respect to
   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.
   3. Turn Off Lights When Unused (Eco Friendly)– Kindly turn
   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other
   shared areas when not in use.
   4. Pool Etiquette – Please wear proper swimwear and a swim
   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.
   5. Contact Us Directly – If you encounter any issues, please
   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Make sure to log out of your Google and Netflix accounts
   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original
   settings.
   10. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning.
   You don't have to wash them for the team. However, your
   thoughtfulness is well recevied.
   
   Thank you for your cooperation, and we hope you have a
   wonderful stay!

Shun-Hui的群體剛剛退房，現在是您撰寫評價的最佳時間。

評價是Airbnb社區的重要組成部分。請為您的房客留下有用的回饋意見，這只需要花上您幾分鐘的時間。

撰寫評價
[https://www.airbnb.com.tw/hosting/reviews/1455583748823201037/edit?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=8cbc9018-b22e-41fb-350f-d446a01e1eb8]

評價的重要性

房東社區的成員仰賴彼此的分享經驗，在出租時便能放心待客。


想想你接待房客的經驗，以及對方在尊重你的房源和守則時所付出的努力。你想讓其他房東知道什麼？

   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be
   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.

   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.

   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other
   shared areas when not in use.
   4. Pool Etiquette – Please wear proper swimwear and a swim
   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.
   5. Contact Us Directly – If you encounter any issues, please
   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Make sure to log out of your Google and Netflix accounts
   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original
   settings.
   10. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning.
   You don't have to wash them for the team. However, your
   thoughtfulness is well recevied.

   wonderful stay!

   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.

   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be

   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.

   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other
   shared areas when not in use.

   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.

   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Make sure to log out of your Google and Netflix accounts
   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original
   settings.
   10. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning.

Yy的群體剛剛退房，現在是您撰寫評價的最佳時間。

評價是Airbnb社區的重要組成部分。請為您的房客留下有用的回饋意見，這只需要花上您幾分鐘的時間。

評價的重要性

房東社區的成員仰賴彼此的分享經驗，在出租時便能放心待客。

   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.

   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Make sure to log out of your Google and Netflix accounts
   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original
   settings.
   10. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning.

   thoughtfulness is well recevied.

   SIMON
   
   達人
   
   Dear 香里,
   Welcome and thank you for staying with us! Before you settle
   in, please take a moment to review these important house
   rules to ensure a smooth and pleasant experience for
   everyone:
   1. Keep Noise Levels Low – The walls are thin, so please be
   mindful of your volume, especially during night time.
   2. No Running in Hallways – For safety and respect to
   neighbors, please avoid running or making loud noises in the
   common areas.
   3. Turn Off Lights When Unused (Eco Friendly)– Kindly turn
   off lights and equipment in the yoga room, gym, and other
   shared areas when not in use.
   4. Pool Etiquette – Please wear proper swimwear and a swim
   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.
   5. Contact Us Directly – If you encounter any issues, please
   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Make sure to log out of your Google and Netflix accounts
   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original
   settings.
   10. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning.
   You don't have to wash them for the team. However, your
   thoughtfulness is well recevied.
   
   Thank you for your cooperation, and we hope you have a
   wonderful stay!

接待 준 入住的體驗好嗎？

   告訴준的一行幾人您喜歡他們的什麼方面，以及有什麼可以做得更好

준的群體剛剛退房，現在是您撰寫評價的最佳時間。

評價是Airbnb社區的重要組成部分。請為您的房客留下有用的回饋意見，這只需要花上您幾分鐘的時間。

撰寫評價
[https://www.airbnb.com.tw/hosting/reviews/1479425838613940235/edit?c=.pi80.pkaG9tZV9yZXZpZXdzL3JlbWluZGVycy9sZWF2ZV9hX3Jldmlld19maXJzdF9yZW1pbmRlcl90b19ob3N0&euid=7c4d4ef5-c17c-69e9-b202-ba0cf4d03dd7]

評價的重要性

房東社區的成員仰賴彼此的分享經驗，在出租時便能放心待客。


想想你接待房客的經驗，以及對方在尊重你的房源和守則時所付出的努力。你想讓其他房東知道什麼？


真誠的意見可以建立信任，因此你和房東均可評價入住／接待體驗，而我們只會在 14 天或雙方均寫完評價後才發布內容。

   cap, and avoid dripping water through the building on your
   way to and from the pool.

   reach out to us directly. The front desk staff is not
   responsible for Airbnb-related matters.
   6. No Items in Hallways – Please do not leave any personal
   belongings or trash in the hallways.
   7. Key Card Responsibility – Always carry your key card and
   avoid losing it. Replacement cards may incur a fee.
   8. Wet Towels – Please do not store wet towels in closets or
   drawers. Hang them to dry to avoid odors and mold.
   9. Make sure to log out of your Google and Netflix accounts
   to safeguard your privacy. If you change the language
   setting of the TV, please restore it to the original
   settings.
   10. Dirty Towels – We will handle all the towel cleaning.
   You don't have to wash them for the team. However, your
   thoughtfulness is well recevied.
   
   Thank you for your cooperation, and we hope you have a
   wonderful stay!
